methodology.summary: Budgets are ratios between two scenarios measured in the same process and the same run. An absolute nanosecond limit is not portable between a workstation and a shared CI runner, so it would fail on a busy machine instead of on a regression.
methodology.feature_overhead_rationale: A bare `await handler()` costs about 100ns, close enough to loop and timer overhead that it moved by 2x between calibration runs. Dividing a ~10us runtime path by it inherits that noise. compiled_invoke is the same order of magnitude as the paths being budgeted and moves with the same machine conditions.

calibration.observed_ratio_spread_across_runs: V1-40 current-semantic records: 1.07x-1.75x for complete-path ratios; 1.54x for startup scaling; 1.37x for registration scaling

methodology.headroom_policy: Each limit is at least 1.6x the largest value in the three V1-40 current-semantic records, rounded upward where a new limit is introduced. Existing more-conservative ceilings remain unchanged. Limits are not a claim that Agnara is fast.

dependency_injection_one.note: Cost of resolving one invocation-scoped dependency.

dependency_injection_ten.note: Ten dependencies must stay well below ten times one dependency.

policy_evaluation_one.note: One always-allow policy. Evaluation is the measured path; a denying policy would short-circuit.

policy_evaluation_three.note: Policy evaluation must stay close to linear and cheap.

execution_identity.note: Carrying a principal and a correlation id must stay near free.

idempotency_miss.note: Claim plus complete against the store. This is the metric that exposed the O(n^2) in-memory store sweep.

nested_depth_one.note: One nested capability invocation through the runtime.

nested_depth_three.note: Three levels must stay near three times one level, not super-linear.

embedded_runtime_invoke.note: ADR 0094's complete host-to-runtime boundary, including frozen-registry lookup and canonical result projection.

streaming_unit.note: Per emitted unit, so a stream unit must stay cheaper than a whole complete-result invocation.

compiled_invoke.note: What the framework costs over a bare awaited handler. Deliberately coarse: the bare handler is the noisiest measurement here, so this guards against the runtime roughly doubling, not against small drift.

startup_scaling_ratio.note: Compile cost per capability at 1,000 capabilities divided by the cost at 100. Catches compilation that stops being linear in the number of capabilities. The preserved calibration has three records; V1-40 will refresh its repeated-run variance before changing this limit. A genuinely quadratic regression shows up as roughly 10x.

registration_scaling_ratio.note: Registration plus freeze cost per capability at 1,000 capabilities divided by the cost at 100. Catches super-linear synchronized-registry growth independently of plan compilation.

startup_peak_bytes_per_capability.note: Peak compile memory per capability. Allocation counts are deterministic across runs, so this limit can be tighter than the timing limits.
